subject: Request: Early-exit & ramp protections — approval needed for StratPar opportunity
messages:
From: Alexandra Pierce <procurement@stratpar.com>
To: Jonas Weber <jonas.weber@redwood.com>
Date: Tue, 14 Sep 2026 09:15:00 -0700
Subject: Redwood proposal — request on ramp / early termination flexibility

Hi Jonas,

Thanks again for the demo last week — StratPar is excited about the latency/cost profile you showed. We're running this through procurement and legal and have a few sticking points on the commercial side before we can commit. The main asks from our side are:

- A six-week opt-out window during the initial ramp so we can walk away with minimal penalty if performance doesn't meet our expectations.
- Clear downsell protections: if we reduce committed units within the first 3 months we want a prorated credit instead of a 100% early termination fee.
- A ramp schedule that phases committed units over 90 days rather than full commit day 1.

Would Redwood be able to accommodate those guardrails? If so, also please include any discount you can offer to make the first-year economics work — our sponsor is pushing for a meaningful first-year concession.

Attaching the RFP excerpt for context (section B, pricing & termination).

Thanks,
Alexandra Pierce
Senior Procurement Manager
StratPar Systems
Attachment: StratPar_RFP_excerpt.pdf
From: Jonas Weber <jonas.weber@redwood.com>
To: Alexandra Pierce <procurement@stratpar.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>, Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwood.com>
Date: Tue, 14 Sep 2026 11:02:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Redwood proposal — request on ramp / early termination flexibility

Alexandra — thanks for the clarity and for sending the excerpt. I've outlined a customer-friendly option that would be contingent on exec/finance/legal sign-off:

1) Ramp schedule: staggered commit over 90 days (25% / 35% / 40%) — see attached draft schedule.
2) Early-exit/opt-out: allow opt-out after 6 weeks with a prorated credit pool equal to unused committed spend for remainder of month, capped at $75k.
3) Downsell protection: allow one-time downsize in first 90 days with no termination fee; subsequent downsizes revert to standard termination provisions.
4) Commercial concession: propose a year-1 discount of 25% on unit pricing (trade for a 12-month minimum contractual term).

We can offer the above but I need formal approval for the 25% concession and the cap on credits (the credit cap is a finance ask). If execs prefer, we can offer 15% discount with more generous credit cap.

I've attached: proposed_ramp_schedule.xlsx and a commercial_summary.pdf with the math. Marissa / Laura — can you weigh in on the risk/approval path?

Alexandra — I'll keep you posted; internal approvals required before we lock in.

—Jonas
Account Executive, Redwood Inference
Attachment: proposed_ramp_schedule.xlsx; commercial_summary.pdf
From: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>
To: Jonas Weber <jonas.weber@redwood.com>
Cc: Rishi Malhotra <rishi.malhotra@redwood.com>, Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwood.com>, Vivek Kulkarni <vivek.kulkarni@redwood.com>
Date: Wed, 15 Sep 2026 09:30:00 -0700
Subject: Fwd: Redwood proposal — request on ramp / early termination flexibility — approval ask

Jonas / team — forwarding Jonas' note and attachments. Summary of the ask: 25% year-1 discount + 6-week opt-out with prorated credits (credit cap proposed at $75k) + 90-day staggered ramp. Customer will sign a 12-month minimum if we accept.

Recommendation: Approve a middle-ground commercial concession to win the account without opening a broad precedence. I recommend: 15% year-1 discount + opt-out after 8 weeks (to give SRE time to prove perf) + credit cap $50k + single downsize protection in first 90 days. That preserves revenue while showing flexibility.

If Finance approves the credit cap and Legal can craft a narrowly scoped amendment (explicitly limited to this deal with no blanket language), I think we can move to signature this week.

Attachment: deal_summary_onepager.pdf

Marissa Cole
Head of Sales Ops, Redwood Inference
From: Rishi Malhotra <rishi.malhotra@redwood.com>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>, Jonas Weber <jonas.weber@redwood.com>
Cc: Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwood.com>, Vivek Kulkarni <vivek.kulkarni@redwood.com>
Date: Thu, 16 Sep 2026 10:45:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Fwd: Redwood proposal — request on ramp / early termination flexibility — approval ask

Quick finance read: the 25% concession materially impacts ARR and our Q4 bookings. We can't approve 25% off the board given the size of the commit. If the customer is delivering a bona fide 12-month minimum, we could accept up to 15% as a carve-out.

On credits/caps: I support a capped credit approach. Proposed acceptable terms from finance: 15% year-1 discount; opt-out after 8 weeks (not 6); credit pool cap $50,000; credits applied as service credit over remaining months (no cash refunds). If customer insists on a higher credit cap, require an escrow or prepayment mechanism.

Attached is a quick forecast showing P&L impact at various discount levels. We need legal to limit precedent risk in the amendment language.

Attachment: forecast_impact.xlsx

—Rishi
Director, Revenue Finance
From: Vivek Kulkarni <vivek.kulkarni@redwood.com>
To: Jonas Weber <jonas.weber@redwood.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>, Rishi Malhotra <rishi.malhotra@redwood.com>, Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwood.com>
Date: Thu, 16 Sep 2026 17:42:00 -0700
Subject: RE: Fwd: Redwood proposal — request on ramp / early termination flexibility — approval ask

Team — after reviewing the recommendation and finance impact, I approve a modified concession to close StratPar:

- Approve 15% discount on year-1 pricing
- Approve opt-out no earlier than week 8 (gives us runway to stabilize production)
- Approve a credit pool capped at $50,000 applied as service credit (no cash refunds)
- Approve single downsize protection in first 90 days (no termination fee for that one-time downsize)

Laura — please prepare a narrowly scoped amendment that: (1) implements the above precisely, (2) includes explicit no-precedent language, and (3) requires customer signature within 7 days of delivery or offers revert to standard list pricing.

Jonas — inform Alexandra of the approved terms and share the amendment timeline; let's aim to get this signed this week. Marissa / Rishi — loop Legal if any additional escrow/prepayment language is needed.

I'll sign off on the amendment once Laura pushes the final draft into DocuSign.

Vivek Kulkarni
VP, Sales — Redwood Inference
